sgssi.title: Flag of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

countryData.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
countryData.officialName: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands (British Overseas Territory)

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the Southern Ocean.
The ice and snow of South Georgia.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms featuring a reindeer, macaroni penguin, fur seal, and the motto 'Leo Terram Propriam Protegat'
- Adopted 3 February 1999
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton. The coat of arms appears in the fly half
trivia:
- South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands use the Union Jack
- Extremely remote British territory with minimal population
- Used primarily for scientific research and wildlife protection
